Given: 5 ÷ 1 × 3 ÷ 4 − 2

It means: 5 is the father of 1, 1 is the wife of 3, 3 is the father of 4 and 4 is the brother of 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73fd2302abb2792577788449dac0267071f2db417467328cc9fde6ebb1af22e9.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1339cb75213086282e6a8e6f9516ba4e791f96a4ac9561a73590380a822bd3be.png] 

So, 5 is the **"Mother's father" **of 2.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother's father".
